integrity: The graph, all simplices, acyclic matching, signed Morse boundary and independent original mod-two ranks are reproduced by the included standalone Python standard-library script. Independent validation has not been undertaken.
scientific_limitations: Only the explicit Pappus graph at two-independence cutoff is covered. Published chordal, tree and other-graph classifications do not imply this claim. Equivalent unindexed work remains a risk; no infinite-family theorem, equivariant action or shellability theorem is asserted.
title: Mixed-dimensional integral homotopy of the Pappus two-independence complex
